content:
pranav: Heads-up: multiple SAST jobs failing in ci/sast on main — looks related to the keystore RBAC change this morning. Error shows decrypt denied for scanner service account. Anyone owns the change?

heather: I flipped a binding for infra-keystore-readers at 09:12 — intended to remove one stale group. Didn't expect scanner SA to be tied to that group.

morgan: Link to failing run: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/12345 — logs show KMS decrypt: AccessDenied.

pranav: paste of last error from the runner:
```
Error: kms.Decrypt permission denied for serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-key
correlation_id=abc123
```

scan-bot: sast: 12 runs failed in last 10m; auto-alert to #incidents in 15m if not triaged.

danielle: Recommend temporary mitigation: grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to the scanner SA scoped to that specific key. I can open an infra-iam PR for emergency grant + TTL.

pranav: Could we instead add the scanner SA back to the keystore-readers group? That seems narrower (group-level) vs granting an explicit role. Concern: audit trail — want clear change log.

leo: Also we should ensure we capture audit evidence: add a tag or annotation in CI when we perform decrypts (e.g., "sast-ci") and ship the decrypt request metadata to central-audit. Compliance will want a record.

heather: I can revert my binding change in ~30m if people prefer. But prefer an infra lead to sign-off before revert.

morgan: Danielle — please open the PR with two options (temp grant to SA with TTL, and a revert of my earlier change) so we can pick the fastest to restore green.

danielle: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/iam/pulls/678 — contains terraform patch granting cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to the scanner SA with a 4-hour TTL via an automation label, plus a rollback commit to reinstate the original group binding if needed. I added a note to set audit log retention for keystore decrypt events to 90 days. cc @sec-oncall

sec-oncall: Approving emergency grant for scanner SA for 4 hours. Please ensure TTL is enforced and file an incident ticket with timeline + affected runs.

danielle: Applied grant via infra-automation. Re-running SAST jobs now.

scan-bot: sast: re-run in progress — 11 runs passing, 1 job queued (flaky).

pranav: Good. Action items from this thread: 1) Postmortem documenting root cause (orphaned group membership + lack of preflight for RBAC changes); 2) Add an infra-change preflight CI step that performs a scoped KMS decrypt smoke-test in staging; 3) Add an alert on KMS Decrypt failure rate (threshold: >5 failures in 10m) to channel eng-security and paging; 4) Ensure audit logs include CI job id and requester identity for decrypt ops.

heather: I'll draft the rollback PR and coordinate with infra leads tomorrow morning (keep the emergency grant TTL in place until then).

morgan: I'll add the preflight smoke test in infra repo: a simple terraform-plan-checker job that runs a test decrypt using a test key and test SA.

pranav: I'll open the incident ticket, attach logs + timeline, and assign postmortem owners.

scan-bot: incident created INC-2026-0421-12 — summary: SAST pipeline outage due to keystore RBAC change, temporary grant applied, follow-ups created.

danielle: thanks all — keeping notes in the PR and incident ticket. We'll close the loop after the postmortem.
